instructions: ill_cond_50 has condition number κ≈1000. dynamic_hmc's default integration_steps_fn = Uniform(1,10) draws trajectory lengths too short to traverse the elongated posterior axes at this condition number. NUTS (nuts + window_adaptation_diag_imm) is the recommended sampler for this model.
workflow:
Phase 3c (2026-05-19): ill_cond_50 x window_adaptation_diag_imm x dynamic_hmc FAILed with rhat=1.17-1.68, ess=6-17 across all 4 dynamic_hmc/dmhmc cells. The failure mode is consistent: random-L ∈ [1,10) from blackjax's default integration_steps_fn is far too short to traverse the elongated posterior axes at κ≈1000.

Diagnosis: At κ≈1000 the long posterior axis requires roughly sqrt(κ)≈32 leapfrog steps to traverse (rule of thumb: L ~ sqrt(κ) / (2*pi) per orbit), so even L=10 at the top of the uniform range gives roughly 1/3 of a proper orbit. The warmup adapts the diagonal IMM which compresses the condition number, but the residual κ after adaptation still demands L >> 10.

Attempted configurations:
1. Phase 3c default: ta=0.8, integration_steps_fn=Uniform(1,10) -> FAIL (rhat=1.68, ess=6, div=0).

Phase 4 plan (Option B, per ratified plan): pre-declare FAILED with HARD_DIRECTION. A Phase 5 investigation could try passing a custom integration_steps_fn=lambda key: jax.random.randint(key, (), 50, 200) via sampler_kwargs_override, but this closure is non-serialisable to JSON and would require a Recipe schema extension. Option A was deferred because Cluster 4 was the lowest-priority cluster and turn budget was limited.

Recommendation: use nuts + window_adaptation_diag_imm (LOW recipe exists at low__nuts__window_adaptation_diag_imm.json) or ill_cond_50 x W2 x nuts (also a LOW recipe).
